description: This file defines the FormOperations class which reacts to form operations within Drupal's workspace module, including form alteration, validation, and AJAX workspace persistence.

classes.name: FormOperations
classes.description: Handles form alterations, validation, and AJAX workspace persistence in Drupal's workspace module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting workspace manager and query parameter negotiator dependencies.

methods.name: formAlter
methods.description: Alters the form to handle workspace context, including setting active workspace, adding validation, and managing AJAX.

methods.name: addWorkspaceValidation
methods.description: Recursively adds validation handlers to form elements.

methods.name: validateDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Validation callback that enforces form submission only in the default workspace.

methods.name: setAjaxWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures workspace context persists across AJAX interactions by modifying AJAX options.
